name: Upwork Inc.
blurb: Upwork Inc. operates an online marketplace that connects businesses with independent professionals and freelancers. The platform enables clients to hire talent for a wide range of projects, from software development to creative services. As a leading player in the gig economy, Upwork competes with platforms like Fiverr and has faced challenges in customer growth and revenue expansion.
recent: Upwork is set to report earnings on May 7, 2026, with analysts expecting revenue growth of 1.7% year-over-year. The stock has declined 8.7% over the past month, underperforming the consumer internet sector, which rose 11.8% on average. The company's last quarter showed a 3.6% revenue increase but a 5.6% drop in active customers, and guidance missed expectations.
